topic: Mexico shower-head maximum flow (NOM-008-CONAGUA) and shower length

findings.what: Maximum showerhead flow rate under NOM-008-CNA-1998 (regular, any pressure class)
findings.quote: baja presión (low pressure) has a maximum of 10 L/min at 98 kPa, media presión (medium pressure) has a maximum of 10 L/min at 294 kPa, and alta presión (high pressure) has a maximum of 10 L/min at 588 kPa

findings.what: Maximum showerhead flow restated by secondary summary of the standard
findings.quote: su flujo máximo es de 10 litros por minuto

findings.what: 'Ecological' showerhead classification threshold under the standard
findings.quote: un flujo de agua de 1 a 2 litros por minuto

findings.what: 'Ecological' showerhead threshold per a different secondary source summarizing the same standard (minimum flow under which a showerhead may be marketed as ecológica)
findings.quote: When the minimum flow is less than 3.8 liters per minute, the showerhead can be classified as 'ecological,' though in no case should the maximum flow rate be exceeded.

findings.what: Proposed (not yet confirmed in force) updated maximum flow rates in a 2018 draft modification to the standard
findings.quote: regular showerheads have a maximum flow of 8.5 L/min, while ecological showerheads have a maximum of 7.0 L/min

notFound.what: Any measured/surveyed average shower length (minutes) specific to Mexico
looked: WebSearch: average shower length minutes Mexico survey
Springer article on shower habits was for southern Spain, not Mexico
EPA, Healthline, sensibledigs, showeraddict, aquabliss shower-time articles all gave US/UK/Switzerland figures (~7-8 min), none for Mexico
